## Changes

- Copy a stopped local server into a new folder with separate ports, new admin credentials, cleared join/player identity and disabled lobby publication. Preserve the source, stage the result and support cancellation; advanced YAML/plugin/cfg copying is opt-in.
- Save basic track/slot/settings presets from saved server files, rename/delete them in a per-user library, and apply them explicitly in the creation wizard.
- Preserve wizard identity, runtime source, paths, ports and passwords when applying presets. Check missing content before changing controls and confirm replacement of a populated car draft.
- Add fuel, damage, tyre wear, slot-limit and practice-duration/infinite choices to the wizard and review. Preserve the selected track layout when returning through Basics.
- Use dark primary buttons with orange outlines for clearer labels, and slimmer muted blue-grey scrollbars with brighter hover and drag states.
- Add a consistent subtle window outline, brighter for the active window and hidden when maximized.
- Add core and WPF regression checks for copying, presets, cancellation, privacy, source consistency and running-source guards.

## Download

Extract the complete `ACServerManager-0.8.0-preview-win-x64.zip` and run `AssettoServerManager.exe`. Windows x64; .NET is included. Game content, AssettoServer and Content Manager remain separate installations.

## Preview limits

Presets contain basic practice-server choices, not full configurations or content. Copying does not package external paths or guarantee plugin compatibility; inspect the selected advanced files before starting. Preset import/export and remote management are deferred. A copy is never started automatically.
